# eraTW test save

`save18.sav` is a preserved copy of the eraTW slot 18 save used by the clock and character-image
regressions. Its SHA-256 digest is
`b43db9ca75e76674e15e03ba7342a5e8b39640dff4f0d3dc431a435c633dd24b`.

The test reaches the relevant state exclusively through visible game inputs: load the save, choose
`100` (睜開眼睛), choose `995` (自動時停移動), then choose `482` (追踪霊夢).
